entries.name: PMData
entries.used_for: Normal days for the four crew replays; Readiness target for Forecast B. Daily values reshaped into StellarForge Readings; crew A has a planted drift.
entries.citation: Thambawita V. et al., PMData: A Sports Logging Dataset, MMSys '20, doi:10.1145/3339825.3394926

entries.name: Pulse Physiology Engine (Kitware)
entries.used_for: Simulated chest-pain collapse and cardiac arrest (emergency replay) and simulated normal blood pressure. Estimate, not validated.

entries.name: NASA OSDR Environmental Data App (EDA), mission RR-1
entries.licence: Open download, cited as visualization under the NASA OSDR terms
entries.used_for: ISS cabin temperature, humidity, CO2 and radiation dose replay (2014 rodent mission; values as labelled by NASA, not crew-measured).

entries.name: NASA OSDR Inspiration4, OSD-569 (complete blood count)
entries.licence: Processed data public, under the NASA OSDR terms
entries.used_for: Real astronaut blood values as lab Readings.

entries.name: NASA OSDR Inspiration4, OSD-575 (comprehensive metabolic panel)
entries.licence: Processed data public, under the NASA OSDR terms
entries.used_for: Checked the glucose Safety bound against real astronaut values.

entries.name: NASA Apollo Flight Crew Cardiovascular Evaluations (AP005)
entries.licence: NASA public summary tables (NASA SP-368), cited as source; no licence stated
entries.used_for: Return-to-gravity heart rate and blood pressure shift (group means from Table 6 only; raw per-crew values are restricted and not used).

entries.name: CGMacros
entries.restriction: Non-commercial use only, and share-alike: anything derived from it must use the same licence. Kept in its own file so the licence does not spread to the rest of StellarForge.
entries.citation: CGMacros: a scientific dataset for personalized nutrition and diet monitoring, accessed from https://registry.opendata.aws/cgmacros/

entries.name: UBFC-rPPG (DATASET_2, subjects 1, 3, 4, 5, 8)
entries.licence: Research use only (shared for research purpose)
entries.restriction: Research use only. Used only to measure webcam heart-rate error; the videos are not shipped and no face is shown.
entries.used_for: Accuracy check of the webcam heart-rate estimate (mean error 4.9 bpm on 5 people; estimate, not validated).
entries.citation: S. Bobbia, R. Macwan, Y. Benezeth, A. Mansouri, J. Dubois, Unsupervised skin tissue segmentation for remote photoplethysmography, Pattern Recognition Letters, 2017

entries.name: Z-Anatomy models of human anatomy
entries.used_for: 3D body (male and female). Z-Anatomy credits BodyParts3D (Database Center for Life Science), listed by Z-Anatomy as CC-BY-SA 2.1 Japan.

entries.name: Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organ Set, Body, Female (HuBMAP)
entries.used_for: Female organs (heart, lungs, liver, kidneys, organ outline) in the 3D body. Licence as recorded by the 3D / UI lead in frontend/public/models/LICENSE.md.

entries.name: StellarForge 3D files
entries.used_for: The body models we derived from Z-Anatomy and the Human Reference Atlas (share-alike, as their sources require).

entries.licence: Event rules, cited as source; terms not confirmed

entries.licence: NASA web content, cited as source
